items.title: 불황 속 구찌는 가방값 30% 내렸는데…루이비통은 망설이는 '명품의 금기'
items.summary: Gucci cut prices on select handbags (e.g., Padlock line) by roughly 30% as part of a broader repricing push, while Louis Vuitton hesitates to follow given its strict no-discount tradition. Frames the luxury industry's pricing dilemma amid a third straight year of downturn, with both houses deriving over half of sales from middle-class consumers whose spending has pulled back.

items.title: 구찌 가방 95만원 내렸다…콧대 높던 명품업계에 무슨 일이
items.summary: Gucci cut the price of its Mercato Small Tote from KRW 4.45m to KRW 3.5m (-21%, -KRW 950k) starting summer 2026, the first major luxury price cut since Chanel's 2015 reductions. Quotes a marketing professor calling price cuts an 'unavoidable response to weakening demand'; notes the luxury market shrank and the consumer base fell from 400m (2022) to 340m people, while some rivals (Dior, Chanel) instead expand lower-priced lines rather than touching flagship prices.

items.title: "명품 살 돈이 없어요"…중산층 발길 끊기자 루이비통·구찌에 닥친 위기
items.summary: Reports middle-class shoppers withdrawing from luxury spending, squeezing both Louis Vuitton and Gucci; frames this as a structural crisis for brands reliant on aspirational mid-tier buyers rather than a temporary dip, citing weakening mid-price segment growth across the category.

items.title: 가방만 잘 만드는 줄 알았더니…구찌, 이탈리아 패션계 최초 '양성평등 기업' 인증받은 이유
items.summary: Gucci renewed Italy's gender-equality certification (Bureau Veritas), becoming the first Italian luxury fashion brand to secure it, first obtained in 2023. Cites workforce stats (63.4% women globally, 57.3% of management roles) and CEO Francesca Bellettini's quote that the goal is for 'all employees to demonstrate their talents and grow,' beyond legal compliance. Largely corporate-PR framed; treated as neutral per activation-coverage discount.

items.title: 구찌의 새로운 글로벌 앰배서더, 박보검
items.summary: Gucci named actor Park Bo-gum its new global brand ambassador, citing his 'boldness in embracing new roles' and 'delicate intensity' as aligned with the house's aesthetic vision under Demna. Park commented he was glad to 'write a new story atop a century of Gucci heritage.' Pure activation/ambassador-announcement coverage.

items.title: Gucci hand-paints Fall/Winter mural on Shanghai shikumen
items.summary: Gucci unveiled a hand-painted mural of its FW campaign on a shikumen building exterior at Fengshengli in Shanghai's Jing'an district, part of its Art Wall project (since 2017, now five cities). Artists painted on-site via lift rather than using printed banners. Activation/brand-content coverage of China market investment.

items.title: Gucci cuts prices, but will Chinese shoppers return?
items.summary: Independent trade-press analysis questioning whether Gucci's China price cuts (up to 40% on some bags/RTW in September 2026) will actually win back Chinese shoppers, given the brand's deeper perception problem beyond price. Critical/skeptical framing of the recovery narrative, corroborating the price-cut story with an outlet evaluative verdict.

items.title: グッチが中国進出30周年 上海で2028年クルーズコレクション開催
items.summary: Gucci will stage its 2028 cruise show in Shanghai on May 17, 2027, marking 30 years since its first China store opening. Positioned as celebrating Shanghai's creative energy and continuing a history of major Gucci China presentations (2012 FW show, 2021 Aria, 2023/2025 exhibitions). Activation/announcement coverage.

items.source: WWD Japan / Forbes Japan via Yahoo News Japan
items.title: グッチ、異例の値下げで高級ブランド界の掟を破る ルイ・ヴィトンは追随するか
items.summary: Gucci's 'unprecedented' price cuts break the luxury industry's taboo against lowering flagship prices, with the article asking whether Louis Vuitton will follow. Frames Kering CEO Luca de Meo's 'price reset' positioning versus years of markups having outpaced what consumers will bear; links the move to 13 consecutive quarters of declining Gucci sales.

items.title: 구찌, 롯데백화점 에비뉴엘 월드타워점 우먼즈 스토어 오픈
items.summary: Gucci renewed its women's store at Lotte Department Store's Avenuel World Tower in Seoul, emphasizing architectural materials (Italian natural stone, metal detailing) across RTW, bags, shoes, leather goods, jewelry, watches, eyewear and silk accessories. Pure retail-activation coverage.

items.title: 田曦薇宋威龙这次在成都参加的是什么品牌活动？
items.summary: Actors Tian Xiwei and Song Weilong, both Gucci brand ambassadors, appeared together at a Gucci boutique event at Chengdu Taikoo Li on Nov 27 in coordinated all-black leather looks (reportedly Gucci 2027 pre-spring). The pairing drove a trending Weibo topic with users calling them a 'strong model-face combo' and comparing them to 'Mr. & Mrs. Smith'; fan/ambassador enthusiasm, magnitude damped per fandom-trap guidance.

items.title: 宋威龙古驰品牌大使造型写真
items.summary: Posed photos of Song Weilong in a glossy leather suit from Gucci's Core 2027 spring line circulated widely on Weibo, tied to the Chengdu ambassador event; fan-driven engagement around styling, no independent critical commentary.

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？降价40%、Demna首秀、美妆易主，3个维度说清+FAQ
items.summary: Recurring Weibo explainer-thread format summarizing recent Gucci developments for Chinese readers: up to 40% price cuts in China, Demna's debut collection, and the beauty license move from Coty to L'Oreal (EUR 4bn, 50-year deal). Mixed factual recap rather than opinion; indicates sustained organic search/discussion volume around Gucci's turnaround narrative on Weibo.

items.title: [취재썰] '12만원 구찌 가방' 들고 명품 수선집 가보니
items.summary: Korean community thread discussing a reporter's visit to a luxury repair shop with a KRW 120,000 counterfeit 'Gucci' bag versus an authentic bag priced around KRW 3.15m, sparking discussion about counterfeit quality and the growing price gap/perception issues around Gucci authenticity. Mildly negative framing around counterfeit proliferation and price-value comparison.

items.title: 구찌 시계 장단점(인증)
items.summary: Community review of Gucci watches (Snake line) noting strong brand recognition but criticizing finishing quality and movement grade versus similarly-priced competitors. Quality/value-for-money complaint from a hobbyist community, genuine consumer-level critical sentiment.

items.title: "절대 값 안 내린다더니"…오픈런 사라진 한국에 백기 든 '명품'의 굴욕
items.summary: Reports that Korea's luxury 'open-run' (overnight queuing) culture has disappeared as brands including Gucci lower prices, framed as an embarrassing reversal of the industry's historic pricing-power stance. Tone is pointedly critical of the luxury category's prior arrogance, with Gucci cited as a central example.

items.title: 구찌는 가격 인하, 루이비통은 고수…명품업계의 딜레마
items.summary: Business-press analysis contrasting Gucci's price-cut strategy with Louis Vuitton's refusal to budge, framing this as a structural dilemma across the luxury industry rather than Gucci-specific weakness, but implicitly flags Gucci's position as the more distressed one forced to act first.

items.title: 뎀나의 첫 구찌 컬렉션, 패션 전문가들의 반응?
items.summary: Trade-press roundup of expert critic reactions to Demna's debut Gucci collection: curator Pamela Golbin called it clear in intent, noting visible Balenciaga DNA alongside echoes of Tom Ford and Alessandro Michele; Barbara Franchin praised his storytelling via irony and retro sexiness; Christos Garkinos called it satisfactory overall but more a 'teaser' than a definitive direction. Independent critical judgment, not brand-staged activation, carrying genuine mixed-to-positive verdict. Older item retained for context only given limited same-week fresh critic commentary; flagged as outside the ideal freshness window.
